answer_1.quote: We focus on the retrieval-based goal-oriented dialog tasks, where a training data d i usually contains a triple (H i , y i , R). H i denotes the dialog history consisting of all user utterances and system responses up to the current turn, R is a set of given candidate responses and y i is the index of the correct response in R. The main task is to train an end-to-end dialog model to predict y i from R based on H i.

answer_2.quote: Following , we report the user-perceived per-turn accuracy ('per-turn accuracy' is used in the remainder of the paper), where the prediction of one turn is considered correct if the model either selects the right response by itself or asks human.
